title: Sales Administrator
description:
We are recruiting on behalf of our client, a prominent multi-franchise approved car dealer group based in Cardiff, for a Vehicle Sales Administrator.

The role of Vehicle Sales Administrator offers a competitive salary of up to 29,120 per annum, depending on experience, coupled with excellent benefits.

- Enhanced annual leave entitlement
- Staff purchase discounts
- Access to full manufacturer-accredited training and development schemes
- Ongoing career progression within a leading dealer group
- 40-hour work week, Monday to Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm

Duties as a Vehicle Sales Administrator will involve:

- Liaise with the sales team regarding vehicle progress and customer updates

Requirements:

- Strong organisational skills and excellent communication abilities
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Excel, and DMS systems (Kerridge/CDK experience preferred)
- A valid UK driving licence with minimal points (beneficial but not essential)
- Ability to deliver high levels of administrative support and attention to detail
- Willingness to undertake relevant automotive sales administration training if necessary

Contact Harry Thaxton-Woodcock, Automotive Recruitment Specialist at Perfect Placement covering Cardiff and South Wales, today to discover more about this fantastic Sales Administrator opportunity.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented Sales Administrator to join our team in St Mellons.

This is a key role within the business, taking responsibility for the full sales administration process, from initial customer enquiries and quotations through to order processing, dispatch and delivery. You will work closely with customers and colleagues across Sales, Production, Warehouse, Logistics and Finance to ensure orders are processed accurately, deadlines are met and customers receive an excellent level of service.

- Prepare quotations, order confirmations, invoices and relevant sales documentation.

- Liaise with customers and internal departments to ensure orders are fulfilled accurately and on time.
- Prepare export and shipping documentation where required.
- Maintain accurate customer and order records and assist with sales reporting.

You will be exceptionally organised, have excellent attention to detail and take pride in seeing tasks through to completion. You will be confident communicating with different departments, managing competing priorities and taking the initiative to resolve issues without needing constant supervision.

We are looking for someone who is dependable, customer-focused and comfortable taking ownership of their workload.

Ideally, you will have:

Experience in sales administration, order processing or a similar role.

Good IT skills and confidence using Microsoft Office.

Experience with Sage 200, Salesforce and export documentation.

Experience with these systems and export processes is advantageous but not essential, as training can be provided for the right candidate. A positive attitude, strong organisational skills and a willingness to learn are what matter most.

- Salary (phone number removed) depending on experience
- 35-hour week

description: Llandaff North Medical Centre is looking for a receptionist/administrator to join our multi-disciplinary team. The key role of the Receptionist/Administrator is to effectively contribute to the Practice team by assisting the clinical team in the provision of services to patients by facilitating access and undertaking various administrative & support duties in an organised, efficient, timely and courteous manner. Applicants should be aware that you will be part of the reception team, working on a rota basis between the core hours of Monday to Friday 07.45am to 6:30pm. You must be available to work 'late' shifts until 6:30pm and be fully flexible on days. Working days and hours will be confirmed with the successful candidate but will include a full day on a Tuesday. You will be supporting & supported by the wide range of clinical and non-clinical team within the practice. We value precision, attention to detail and being able to work independently while being part of a supportive and patient-focused team. The candidate must have experience in a healthcare setting and be familiar with clinical I.T. systems. Knowledge of medical terminology is essential. The delivery of Reception and administrative services to ensure an effective and professional service to patients and the Practice team. The role will be varied and will involve care navigating patients to the right services. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILTIES Answer the telephone in line with Practice telephone protocol. Make appointments and generally attend to patients requests in a prompt, professional and courteous manner. Give information to patients clearly, taking into account their individual needs and relay messages accurately to appropriate practice staff.
